steps.name: Environment preparation and persistent PATH
steps.description: Ensure python3 and pip are available, create user-site bin dir, persist PATH via /etc/profile.d with a runtime-evaluated snippet (no write-time substitution), export PATH and PYTHONUSERBASE into the current session so subsequent non-interactive steps immediately see --user installs, and create the workspace directory.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "python3 not found" >&2; exit 2; }
# ensure user-site & bin exist for the interpreter
USER_BASE=$(python3 -m site --user-base 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "${USER_BASE}" ]; then
  mkdir -p "${USER_BASE}/bin"
else
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
  USER_BASE="$HOME/.local"
fi
# write a profile.d script that evaluates user-base at runtime (idempotent)
PROFILE_FILE="/etc/profile.d/streamlit_env.sh"
MARK="# tic_tac_toe_native_app: ensure user bin on PATH"
PROFILE_CONTENT='#!/usr/bin/env bash
# tic_tac_toe_native_app: ensure user bin on PATH
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  UB=$(python3 -m site --user-base 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "${UB}" ]; then
    export PATH="${UB}/bin:$PATH"
    export PYTHONUSERBASE="${UB}"
  fi
fi
# fallback
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
'
if ! sudo grep -q -- "${MARK}" "$PROFILE_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$PROFILE_CONTENT" | sudo tee "$PROFILE_FILE" >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
fi
# ensure current session sees user bin and PYTHONUSERBASE (non-persistent for this shell)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONUSERBASE="${USER_BASE}"
# ensure workspace exists
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"

steps.description: Create minimal project structure in the workspace: requirements.txt with REQUIREMENTS_PIN guidance, import-safe app_core.py, a Streamlit-friendly app.py (calls render at top-level when run by Streamlit), optional .streamlit/config.toml for default server settings, and a start.sh entrypoint that runs Streamlit headless. steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
REQUIREMENTS_PIN="${REQUIREMENTS_PIN:-streamlit>=1.20.0,<2.0.0}"
cat > requirements.txt <<EOF
# Minimal runtime dependencies (change REQUIREMENTS_PIN before deps step if needed)
$REQUIREMENTS_PIN
# numpy  # uncomment if used
EOF
# app_core (import-safe)
if [ ! -f app_core.py ]; then
  cat > app_core.py <<'PY'
import streamlit as st

def render_app():
    st.title('Tic Tac Toe (dev)')
    st.markdown('Place your application code here.')

PY
fi
# app.py: Streamlit imports and runs render_app when executed/imported by streamlit
if [ ! -f app.py ]; then
  cat > app.py <<'PY'
from app_core import render_app

# Streamlit will import this file; calling render_app at import time ensures UI loads
render_app()

PY
fi
# optional .streamlit config for headless defaults
mkdir -p .streamlit
cat > .streamlit/config.toml <<'CF'
[server]
headless = true
port = 8501
enableCORS = false
enableXsrfProtection = false
address = "0.0.0.0"
CF
# start script
cat > start.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
STREAMLIT_ARGS="${STREAMLIT_ARGS:-}"
exec python3 -m streamlit run app.py --server.headless true --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 $STREAMLIT_ARGS
SH
chmod +x start.sh

steps.name: Install Python dependencies (user) with pip sanity check
steps.description: Install Python dependencies from requirements.txt using python3 -m pip (non-root). Parse `python3 -m pip --version` reliably, optionally upgrade pip in user context if extremely old, install requirements into user site, verify Python can import installed packages by checking site.getusersitepackages(), and print installed streamlit version and warn if it doesn't satisfy REQUIREMENTS_PIN.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$(python3 -m site --user-base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local") }"
PIP_INFO=$(python3 -m pip --version 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$PIP_INFO" ]; then
  echo "pip not available for python3" >&2; exit 3
fi
# parse pip major version number from 'pip X.Y.Z from ...'
PIP_VER=$(echo "$PIP_INFO" | awk '{print $2}' )
PIP_MAJOR=$(echo "$PIP_VER" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
if [ "$PIP_MAJOR" -lt 1 ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --upgrade --user pip --quiet || true
fi
# install deps via python3 -m pip to avoid PATH reliance
python3 -m pip install --upgrade --user -r requirements.txt --quiet
# verify usersite is present and streamlit importable
USERSITE=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import site,sys
try:
  print(site.getusersitepackages())
except Exception:
  print('')
PY
)
if [ -z "$USERSITE" ] || [ ! -d "$USERSITE" ]; then
  echo "warning: python user-site not found: $USERSITE" >&2
fi
INSTALLED_STREAMLIT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
try:
  import streamlit as s
  print(getattr(s,'__version__',''))
except Exception:
  print('')
PY
)
if [ -z "$INSTALLED_STREAMLIT" ]; then
  echo "streamlit not importable after install" >&2; exit 6
fi
echo "streamlit $INSTALLED_STREAMLIT"
# optionally warn if REQUIREMENTS_PIN set and mismatch
if [ -n "${REQUIREMENTS_PIN:-}" ]; then
  echo "REQUIREMENTS_PIN=${REQUIREMENTS_PIN}"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Install Python deps into user site with pip sanity checks
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# ensure user local bin is on PATH for this session
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:${PATH:-}"
# ensure PYTHONUSERBASE is set to a sane default (resolved at runtime)
export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$(python3 -m site --user-base 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local") }"
# Ensure pip is available for python3
PIP_INFO=$(python3 -m pip --version 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$PIP_INFO" ]; then
  echo "error: pip not available for python3" >&2
  exit 3
fi
# parse pip version robustly (second token usually X.Y.Z)
PIP_VER=$(printf "%s" "$PIP_INFO" | awk '{print $2}')
PIP_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$PIP_VER" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
# If pip major version is zero or not numeric, attempt user upgrade (very old pip)
if ! printf "%s" "$PIP_MAJOR" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' || [ "$PIP_MAJOR" -lt 1 ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --upgrade --user pip --quiet || true
fi
# Install requirements into user site (quiet, non-interactive)
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --upgrade --user -r requirements.txt --quiet
else
  echo "warning: requirements.txt not found in $WORKSPACE" >&2
fi
# verify usersite path
USERSITE=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import site
try:
    print(site.getusersitepackages())
except Exception:
    print('')
PY
)
if [ -z "$USERSITE" ] || [ ! -d "$USERSITE" ]; then
  echo "warning: python user-site not found: $USERSITE" >&2
fi
# verify streamlit import and print version
INSTALLED_STREAMLIT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
try:
    import importlib
    s = importlib.import_module('streamlit')
    print(getattr(s, '__version__', ''))
except Exception:
    print('')
PY
)
if [ -z "$INSTALLED_STREAMLIT" ]; then
  echo "error: streamlit not importable after install" >&2
  exit 6
fi
printf "streamlit %s\n" "$INSTALLED_STREAMLIT"
# If REQUIREMENTS_PIN provided, print it and warn on mismatch (simple textual check)
if [ -n "${REQUIREMENTS_PIN:-}" ]; then
  printf "REQUIREMENTS_PIN=%s\n" "${REQUIREMENTS_PIN}"
  # If REQUIREMENTS_PIN looks like a pinned version for streamlit (e.g. streamlit==1.25.0), warn if mismatch
  case "${REQUIREMENTS_PIN}" in
    *streamlit==*)
      PIN_VER=${REQUIREMENTS_PIN#*streamlit==}
      if [ "$PIN_VER" != "$INSTALLED_STREAMLIT" ]; then
        echo "warning: installed streamlit ($INSTALLED_STREAMLIT) does not match REQUIREMENTS_PIN ($PIN_VER)" >&2
      fi
      ;;
  esac
fi

steps.name: Validation: start app, probe endpoint, and stop cleanly
steps.description: Start Streamlit in background (python3 -m streamlit run ...), ensure port 8501 is free (including 0.0.0.0/IPv6 listeners), poll HTTP endpoint for readiness (200 + content check), record all related PIDs (descendants) for reliable cleanup, wait up to READY_TIMEOUT (env, default 60s), provide logs/probe output on failure, and perform recursive shutdown of descendants then parent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
READY_TIMEOUT="${READY_TIMEOUT:-60}"
LOG=streamlit.log
PIDFILE=streamlit.pid
PORT=8501
# check port availability broadly
if ss -ltn | grep -q ':8501' ; then
  echo "port ${PORT} appears in use; cannot start streamlit" >&2
  ss -ltn | grep ':8501' || true
  exit 10
fi
# start streamlit background, capture PID
nohup python3 -m streamlit run app.py --server.headless true --server.port ${PORT} --server.address 0.0.0.0 > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PARENT_PID=$!
echo "$PARENT_PID" > "$PIDFILE"
# collect descendants helper
collect_pids(){
  local pids="$1"; local all="$pids"; for pid in $pids; do
    children=$(pgrep -P "$pid" || true)
    if [ -n "$children" ]; then
      all="$all $children"
      all="$(collect_pids "$children")"
    fi

      break
    fi
  fi

  if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
    P=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)

      DESC=$(collect_pids "$P")
      for dp in $DESC; do kill "$dp" 2>/dev/null || true; done
      kill "$P" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  exit 8
fi
# evidence
echo "STREAMLIT_OK"
echo "---- HTTP probe snippet ----"
head -n 40 "$PROBE_OUT" || true
echo "---- log tail ----"
tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
# cleanup: kill descendant processes recursively then parent
cleanup(){
  if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
    P=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$P" ]; then
      DESC=$(collect_pids "$P")
      # kill descendants first
      for dp in $DESC; do
        kill "$dp" 2>/dev/null || true
      done
      kill "$P" 2>/dev/null || true

      for i in {1..8}; do
        sleep 1

      done
      if kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill -9 "$P" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
    rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
  fi
}

WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/streamlit-tic-tac-toe-255584-255684/tic_tac_toe_native_app}"

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
READY_TIMEOUT="${READY_TIMEOUT:-60}"
LOG=streamlit.log
PIDFILE=streamlit.pid

  echo "port ${PORT} appears in use; cannot start streamlit" >&2
  ss -ltn | grep ":${PORT}" || true
  exit 10

# recursively collect descendant PIDs
collect_pids(){
  local pids="$1" all="$pids" pid children
  for pid in $pids; do
    children=$(pgrep -P "$pid" || true)
    if [ -n "$children" ]; then
      all="$all $children"
      # recurse and append
      all="$all $(collect_pids "$children")"
    fi
  done
  echo "$all"
}
